_doc: The Floodgate's set: Szadi art's RPG Worlds Wetland (RPGW_Wetland_v1.1) for the paved concrete yard, the stone face the pit walls come from, reeds and posts for the margins; Set 1 (RPGFW_Set1_v1.0) for the water blob and fill under the shallows. Keys: tools/cut_tiles.py. Paths are relative to the packs dir.

glint._doc: Wetland's glint loop (10 frames of 32 px; its pixels are already opaque, about 1 % of each tile, so no alpha_mul), lifted from teal to pale blue to sit on the tinted bed, cut in four phase-shifted, mirrored rows so the tiles do not blink in step

water._doc: the channels sit below the floor: a ragged shoulder of Wetland's brown dirt (greyed toward the paving) on the land round them (shoulder, at most about half a tile), then a thin kerb of the pack's mossy cobbles (MainLev tiles 36-38 x 23-25) at the water's edge, running along the top of the far bank's 15 px drop of the Wetland plateau's stone (edge_over_face); the near bank a lit lip; rounded corners; a dark wet line and a shade along the water, deepest under the face

overlay._doc: the pits' far wall: a seamless cliff face from the matching pack; the lip and the cracks: the floor's own fill (tools/cut_tiles.py cut_overlay)

pebbles._doc: Set 1 loose pebbles, found on their own

reeds._doc: Set 1 small water plants and low reed clumps
the two tall clumps only: the sheet's lone stalk beside them ends higher and floated

reeds_small._doc: one clump, feet at its roots (the box's bottom is clear)

reeds_sway._doc: DecorativeProps vegB3, the dense tuft, green (colour row 1 = 32 px row 4); the first four frames of its 10-frame loop; feet on the middle stalk's roots

reed_sway._doc: DecorativeProps vegB1, one stalk, green; its roots end at y 23
